subject: POC/Trial planning & final readout scheduling Aurelia Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Mark Emerson <mark.emerson@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC proposal & success criteria (follow-up from today)

Hi Priya —

Great speaking with you and Mark earlier today. As promised, here’s a concise recap and the proposed POC/trial plan so we can align on success criteria and timeline.

Quick recap:
- Use case: clinical chart summarization + provider note generation for outpatient clinic workflows.
- Volume: ~2k notes/day during trial window.
- Sensitive data: PHI scope limited to de-identified extracts via your ETL.

Proposed POC / trial (2 weeks):
1) Objectives / success criteria (we’ll validate at readout):
   - 90%+ accuracy on extracted diagnosis codes vs. your gold set (sample of 500 notes)
   - Mean generation latency < 800ms for 512-token requests under expected concurrency
   - No PHI leakage in model outputs (manual spot checks + automated filters)
   - Integration quality: < 3 integration bugs blocking evaluation flow

2) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 1: ingest sample data, onboard to a Dedicated trial instance, run baseline tests
   - Week 2: iterative prompt tuning, run scale tests and collect gold comparisons
   - Final readout: 60-min session with execs + technical review to decide go/no-go

3) Timelines & ownership:
   - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (me) — overall POC coordination, data ingestion support
   - Redwood tech lead: Marcus Lin — Dedicated instance setup, perf tuning
   - Aurelia owners: Priya Singh (Product) + Mark Emerson (Finance/Exec sponsor)

4) Next steps (action items):
   - We attach the POC plan (PDF) with explicit test cases and sample data schema. Please confirm the success criteria or propose edits.
   - Can you confirm access to a de-identified sample of ~1k notes by Aug 18?
   - Proposed final readout week: Aug 24–28. Do any of those days work for you/Mark?

Attachments: Redwood-POC-plan.pdf (high-level plan + test cases)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0149

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary and plan. Mark and I reviewed and overall this looks good. A few notes and questions before we lock the dates: 

- Success criteria: the accuracy threshold looks reasonable. Can you add a short doc describing the automated PHI filters you run? We need that for security sign-off.
- Data: we can provide a de-identified sample of ~1,200 notes by Tue Aug 18 EOD. I’ll have the data engineering team push to the secure S3 bucket and share access.
- Cost / billing: can you provide an estimated consumption-based cost for the 2-week Dedicated trial so I can run it by Finance?
- Exec readout: Aug 25 (Wed) afternoon works best for Mark. Can we aim for a 45–60 min readout at 2pm PT?

I’m attaching our internal evaluation checklist so you can see how we’ll score outputs.

Attachments: Aurelia-eval-checklist.xlsx

If you can answer the PHI filter doc + cost estimate, we’ll be ready to proceed.

Best,
Priya Singh

- Marissa: I’ll draft a short cost estimate for a 2-week Dedicated trial (expected token volumes + compute baseline) and share with Priya by EOD Thu Aug 20.

Also attaching an internal runbook with the step sequence (redwood-poc-steps.md) — highlights: data ingestion checklist, integration test endpoints, perf test command lines.

Questions:
- Marcus, do you foresee any infra lead time beyond 24 hours to get the Dedicated instance up and reachable from Aurelia’s S3?
- Rishi, can you aim to have the PHI filter doc by EOD Aug 20 so we can get security sign-off the same day?

Thanks — let’s aim to be ready for smoke tests on Aug 22.

Marissa
